# Urbaki Art

> A comprehensive resource for learning painting, drawing, knitting, and sculptural arts through step-by-step tutorials and artistic techniques.

Urbaki Art provides beginner-friendly guides across multiple art mediums including acrylic, watercolor, oil, and gouache painting, plus drawing, knitting, sculpture, and DIY crafts. The site features curated tutorials, artistic techniques, and art history references to support artists at all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Acrylic Painting
- Watercolor Painting
- Oil Painting
- Gouache Painting
- Step-by-Step Tutorials
- Beginner-Friendly Guides
- Landscape Painting
- Animal Painting
- Flower Painting
- Portrait Painting
- Drawing Techniques
- Painting Techniques
- DIY Art Projects
- Sculpture
- Knitting

## Painting Mediums & Tutorials

- [Painting](https://urbakiart.com/painting): Main painting section covering acrylic, watercolor, oil & gouache tutorials
- [Acrylic](https://urbakiart.com/painting/acrylic): Acrylic painting tutorials for landscapes, animals & flowers step-by-step
- [Watercolor](https://urbakiart.com/painting/watercolor): Watercolor painting tutorials with step-by-step guides for beginners
- [Oil](https://urbakiart.com/painting/oil): Oil painting guides covering still-life, landscape & portrait techniques
- [Gouache](https://urbakiart.com/painting/gouache): Gouache painting techniques & step-by-step guides for landscapes & portraits

## Beginner Project Tutorials

- [7 Acrylic Animals to Paint (Birds, Sea Life & Fantasy)](https://urbakiart.com/acrylic-animals-to-paint): Step-by-step acrylic animal tutorials featuring birds, sea life & fantasy creatures
- [3 Acrylic Painting Ideas Flowers for Beginners](https://urbakiart.com/3-acrylic-painting-ideas-flowers-for-beginners): Beginner acrylic flower tutorials featuring roses, peonies & poppies step-by-step
- [5 Acrylic Painting Landscape Tutorials For Beginners](https://urbakiart.com/5-acrylic-painting-landscape-tutorials-for-beginners): Five acrylic landscape tutorials for beginners covering sunsets, mountains & nature
- [5 Watercolor Ideas (Step-by-Step)](https://urbakiart.com/5-watercolor-ideas-step-by-step): Five watercolor painting ideas with mushrooms, daisies, hydrangeas & portraits
- [7 Watercolor Birds Tutorials (Easy Step-By-Step)](https://urbakiart.com/7-watercolor-birds-tutorials-easy-step-by-step): Seven easy watercolor bird tutorials featuring parrots, cardinals & songbirds
- [Watercolor in 30 Minutes: 5 Fast Painting Tutorials](https://urbakiart.com/watercolor-in-30-minutes-fast-painting-tutorials): Five quick watercolor tutorials completable in 30 minutes or less for beginners

## Drawing & Sketching

- [Draw](https://urbakiart.com/draw): Drawing tutorials covering figures, characters, animals & landscapes
- [5 Drawing Supplies Tips to Start Smart (No Expensive Gear)](https://urbakiart.com/5-drawing-supplies-tips-to-start-smart-no-expensive-gear): Budget-friendly drawing supplies guide with tips for beginners starting smart

## Artistic Techniques & Methods

- [Artistic Techniques](https://urbakiart.com/artistic-techniques): Artistic techniques covering digital art, impasto, pointillism & traditional methods
- [Sculpture](https://urbakiart.com/sculpture): Sculpture guide with clay techniques, character sculpting & finishing methods
- [DIY Art Projects](https://urbakiart.com/diy-art-projects): DIY art projects with air-dry clay, needle-felting, wall art & handmade crafts

## Specialized Art Forms

- [Urbaki Knitting](https://urbakiart.com): Urbaki Art homepage with knitting, patterns, stitches, techniques & tips
- [Tattoo](https://urbakiart.com/tattoo): Tattoo design guide with mandala, small & placement-specific styles

## Art History & Reference

- [Art History](https://urbakiart.com/art-history): Art history featuring famous painters, movements & analysis of masterworks
